python -c "
import re
# Regex from semver.py
_REGEX = re.compile(
        r'''
        ^
        (?P<major>(?:0|[1-9]\d*))
        \.
        (?P<minor>(?:0|[1-9]\d*))
        \.
        (?P<patch>(?:0|[1-9]\d*))
        (\-(?P<prerelease>
            (?:(?:0|[1-9]\d*)|[1-9A-Za-z-][0-9A-Za-z-]*|0[A-Za-z][0-9A-Za-z-]*)
            (\.(?:(?:0|[1-9]\d*)|[1-9A-Za-z-][0-9A-Za-z-]*|0[A-Za-z][0-9A-Za-z-]*))*
        ))?
        (\+(?P<build>
            [0-9A-Za-z-]+
            (\.[0-9A-Za-z-]+)*
        ))?
        $
        ''', re.VERBOSE)

# Test cases from semver.org examples
test_cases = [
    ('0.0.4', True),
    ('1.2.3', True),
    ('10.20.30', True),
    ('1.1.2-prerelease+meta', True),
    ('1.1.2+meta', True),
    ('1.1.2+meta-valid', True),
    ('1.0.0-alpha', True),
    ('1.0.0-beta', True),
    ('1.0.0-alpha.beta', True),
    ('1.0.0-alpha.beta.1', True),
    ('1.0.0-alpha.1', True),
    ('1.0.0-alpha0.valid', True),
    ('1.0.0-alpha.0a', True),  # This should now pass
    ('1.0.0-alpha.test', True),
    ('1.0.0-beta+exp.sha.5114f85', True),
    ('1.0.0+21AF26D3----117B344092BD', True),
    # Invalid cases
    ('1', False),
    ('1.2', False),
    ('1.2.3-0123', False),  # leading zeros in prerelease numeric parts
    ('1.2.3-0123.0123', False),
    ('1.1.2+.123', False),  # empty build metadata
    ('1.2.3-', False),
    ('1.2.3+', False),
]

for version, expected in test_cases:
    match = _REGEX.match(version)
    result = bool(match)
    status = '✓' if result == expected else '✗'
    print(f'{status} {version}: {result} (expected {expected})')
"
